items.title: Adobe Max 2026 Live Updates: All the AI, Photo and Video News - CNET
items.summary: The biggest changes are the general release of AI assistants in Photoshop, Adobe Express and its AI hub, Firefly, first teased at last year’s conference. These assistants are similar to chatbots, where you enter your request and the AI does the editing for you. Adobe also released AI music generation tools and new photo editing modes. For video editors, too, there are the new Premiere mobile apps. [...] Adobe’s flagship programs, like Photoshop, have undergone major AI makeovers, including recent developments like AI audio and soundtrack generation. This has been to the dismay of some of its creative customers who are wary of generative AI. This year is expected to be no different. But there are other tensions brewing, including Adobe’s $75 million settlement with the US Justice Department over subscription cancellations and new vibe-coded and free Adobe alternatives. [...] Adobe tech is also now showing up in ChatGPT and Claude; Disney is using Firefly to help design theme park rides. And from what CNET has heard from Adobe execs, the company isn’t planning to slow down its AI research any time soon.

items.title: Google faces mounting backlash for controversial AI school policy - CBS News
items.summary:
Markey is asking Alphabet if Google will commit to allowing schools to turn off AI features and chatbots in K-12 student accounts while still allowing students to access Google Search. He also requested that Google disclose any research it has conducted on the impact of its AI tools on students' mental health.

Markey has requested that Google disclose any research or testing it has conducted on the safety of its AI functions and their impact on the mental health of K-12 students. [...] Google maintains that its policy change gives schools more control over how they allow AI into schools. An Alphabet spokesperson also told CBS News that Google's AI features are now so tightly integrated into search that it cannot offer the latter without also enabling the AI services. [...] Google faces mounting public pressure to change a new policy that would limit U.S. students' access to the internet giant's widely used search platform unless schools also offer its artificial intelligence-based education tools.

In a letter to Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai on Monday, Sen. Edward Markey demanded that Google's corporate parent reverse the policy, which blocks search for K-12 student accounts that don't also provide access to apps such as Google Classroom.

items.title: AI News Today, November 9: Top Stories | AI Weekly
items.summary: Axon is putting $1.2B into autonomous-drone maker Skydio at a $5.2B pre-money valuation, lifting its stake from roughly 15% to 37% through a mix of ~60% cash and ~40% Axon stock, with only $255M of new primary capital and the rest secondary. The deal makes Axon the exclusive distributor of Skydio drones to US and Canadian public-safety agencies, cementing a public-safety drone duopoly. Axon stock fell ~18% on the news, pressured in part by $130M of counter-drone orders slipping beyond 2026. [...] Google DeepMind said on Nov 6 that AI agents guided by cryptanalysts Nadia Heninger and Emmanuel Thomé found two cryptographic advances against legacy 1024-bit RSA in just weeks, led by DeepMind's Dj Dvijotham and Abhradeep Thakurta. The first makes signature forgery against short-digest 1024-bit RSA roughly 1,600x more efficient; the second cuts the marginal cost of batch-factoring additional 1024-bit keys by about 30x. Modern RSA-2048 is not affected, but DeepMind frames the work as a [...] Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab launched Inkling 2 Small on November 5, a 594B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 17B active parameters and a 292M-parameter vision encoder. The model currently runs closed on Tinker with full Apache 2.0 weights promised next week after external safety testing, and was pretrained on 8.4T tokens before extended reasoning phases out to 1M-token trajectories. It scores 31 on the AA Intelligence Index, 86.3% on SWEBench Pro Hard, and 72.1% on DeepSWE.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: FDA seeks input on telesurgery, autonomous robotics
items.summary: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning and connectivity are driving expansion of robotic applications in a wide range of clinical settings, the FDA said. Increases in processing power, data storage and computational efficiency are enabling progress in robotic systems with autonomous capabilities. [...] In another example of teleoperation, manufacturers are developing devices that enable technicians to remotely perform ultrasounds, the FDA said. Robotic devices include stereotactic navigation systems, imaging devices and endoluminal navigation devices. [...] The FDA is asking the robotics community to submit comments on the discussion paper by Jan. 5. Ahead of that deadline, a public workshop to discuss the topics raised in the paper is scheduled for Dec. 2-3.

items.title: NVIDIA launches GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL - The Robot Report
items.summary:
Walden Robotics is using Isaac Sim’s photorealistic rendering to train and evaluate its general-purpose robot in virtual environments for manufacturing and logistics. Dexmate is exploring how coding agents can rehearse and refine manipulation strategies in Isaac Sim before executing them on its Vega robot. [...] Robotics developers are already putting NVIDIA’s latest technology to the test. A number of developers are using Isaac Lab 3.0 and Newton. At CoRL, Skild AI announced Scalable Throughput-optimized Engine for Embodied Learning, or STEEL, a new rigid-body physics solver built on Newton to accelerate robot training with Isaac Lab. [...] Nexuni is testing GR00T 2 for robotic laundry. Foxconn is applying GR00T 2 to factory automation for server manufacturing, and Siemens is evaluating it across industrial use cases.

MicroAGI is using GR00T 2, post-trained through reinforcement learning, to perform Ethernet cable swapping with a YAM robotic arm. Its agentic robotics approach automates the creation and calibration of simulation environments using Isaac Lab 3.0 and Newton, where the policy is trained.

items.title: OpenAI Tries to Ease Backlash Against AI Data Centers
items.summary:
Broader rules and outside scrutiny would carry more weight than an individual company's promises, Perez-Etchegoyen said.

"OpenAI's own blueprint concedes that voluntary measures don't provide durable confidence. What would reduce uncertainty is the blueprint's proposals becoming law and applying to everyone who builds AI capacity, plus independent verification," he said. "Until then, enterprises should read this as a signal, not a planning assumption." [...] The company said it will disclose site-level water and electricity use, publish construction plans and commission independent noise studies before operations begin and then perform them annually afterward. The company says it will stop requiring nondisclosure agreements from public officials as a condition of negotiations, while retaining narrow protections for security and commercially sensitive information. [...] OpenAI said that the policy proposals build on work the company began in January when it announced its Stargate Community commitments to pay its own way on energy and develop plans shaped by local priorities.

"We followed with specific commitments in Georgia and Ohio, covering energy costs, water use, local investment and accountability," OpenAI wrote. "Today’s announcement is the next step in that ongoing effort."

items.title: As brands dive into ChatGPT, OpenAI will let them track their mentions - Tubefilter
items.summary:
If ChatGPT’s brand dashboard is indeed a play for AEO dollars, it will help answer a question that has followed the chatbot ever since its 2023 ascension: What is the best way for OpenAI to monetize its prized technology? Despite early experiments like the GPT Store, ChatGPT’s share of the LLM market has been shrinking. To bring in more revenue, OpenAI started running ads for lower-tier ChatGPT users, even though CEO Sam Altmanpreviously expressed his distaste for that format. [...] Subscribe

From a marketing standpoint, that’s a rudimentary level of analytics, but by showing brands their ChatGPT mentions, OpenAI can give them tangible evidence of the results of any marketing pushes they make on the platform. As answer engine optimization becomes a valuable marketing category — and the firms running AEO campaigns haul in big funding rounds — OpenAI is bringing improved measurement to that ecosystem. [...] If AI chatbots are going to remain a relevant touchpoint for marketers, then agencies and brands need access to the same analytics they use in their other campaigns. Rumor has it that OpenAIis developing new tools in that area, potentially creating new opportunities for advertisers on ChatGPT.

items.title: ‘Big Short’ Investor Steve Eisman Says OpenAI’s Collapse Could Trigger an Immediate Recession
items.summary:
Steve Eisman warns OpenAI's demise would push the US into an immediate recession, with 70% of NVIDIA's receivables tied to five customers.
 Alphabet's quarterly capex pushed free cash flow negative, while Broadcom's AI chip revenue surged 221% yet leans on a few big customers.
 Eisman assigns 30% odds each to a bear case of recession and market crash and to a bull case. [...] Young trader on Stock Exchange Floor

Shutterstock

 

## Why Eisman Calls OpenAI a Single Point of Failure

His logic runs through capital spending. If OpenAI failed, "the hyperscalers I am sure would cut back on their capex." He added that "this entire AI investment boom has become increasingly dependent on the success of just a few companies." [...] Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT): Quarterly capex hit $39.37 billion, up from $19.39 billion a year earlier, while Azure grew 48%. Its OpenAI stake went from a $3.1 billion loss to a $207 million gain.
 Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN): 2026 capex of roughly $220 billion, with AWS revenue up 39% and new OpenAI agreements.
 Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL): Quarterly capex of $51.36 billion pushed free cash flow to negative $9.06 billion.
